verdict.rationale: Insomnia docs describe a no-login Scratch Pad, a Local Vault storage mode, and Git Sync that keeps data in a user's own repo without cloud servers reading project data (insomnia-docs-31, insomnia-docs-32, insomnia-gh-1, insomnia-docs-22, insomnia-docs-34), supporting fully offline, account-free local workspaces. However, community reports concretely contradict this for the main app: users report Insomnia 'now requires an account,' calling it a 'rug pull' and switching to offline-first alternatives like Bruno (insomnia-comm-14), indicating the broader offline/no-account experience is not reliably honored outside the limited Scratch Pad mode. Missing for 10: consistent first-party confirmation that the full app (not just Scratch Pad) works offline without any account, and resolution of the account-requirement complaint.
